issues.detail: The Hebrew text has Jeremiah (יִרְמְיָהוּ) speaking, but the Vietnamese renders the speaker as 'Ê-xê-ra' (Ezra), a different name. Also, the Hebrew has Irijah (יִרְאִיָּיה) seizing Jeremiah, but the Vietnamese says 'Ích-đê-gia' (Irijah is a different name; 'Ích-đê-gia' is not the standard Vietnamese rendering of יִרְאִיָּיה, which is typically 'Giê-rê-mi' is Jeremiah, but the captor's name is wrong).
